paradigm: Observe -> Understand -> Research -> Build -> Prove -> Select -> Execute -> Analyze -> Learn -> Evolve

prohibit_lookahead_bias.description: Strict prohibition of future data leakage; use only closed bars (.Last(1) / Count - 2)

prohibit_data_leakage.description: Strict separation between In-Sample, Validation, and Out-of-Sample datasets

mandatory_stop_loss.description: Every single order MUST have an approved Stop Loss distance > 0

prohibit_martingale_and_grid.description: Strict prohibition of lot multiplication, unhedged grid, or expanding risk upon drawdown

hard_max_risk_per_trade_pct.description: Maximum risk allocated to any individual order cannot exceed 2.0% of portfolio equity

portfolio_daily_loss_ceiling_usd.description: Daily circuit breaker: all trading halted if daily portfolio loss reaches -$10.00 USD

symbol_max_consecutive_losses.description: Symbol shut down for the day after 2 consecutive stop-outs

max_open_positions.description: Maximum 1 concurrent active position per symbol

daily_flat_enforcement_utc.description: Mandatory liquidation of all open positions by 21:45 UTC; strictly no overnight holding

prohibit_overnight_holding.description: All positions must be closed prior to trading day close / rollover

broker_close_confirmation.description: Verification of actual fill and execution receipt from broker API

demo_environment_quarantine.description: Execution quarantined strictly to Demo; live account transition requires owner OTP/auth

audit_trail_logging.description: Tamper-proof chronological recording of all decisions, regime classifications, and orders

fail_closed_data_sanity.description: Automatic trading halt if data stream freezes, corrupts, or produces NaN values

active_families.name: No Trade
active_families.regime: Thin Liquidity / High Uncertainty / Spread Spike
